argv: $ids=(Get-Process chrome -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Id; Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $ids -contains $_.OwningProcess -and ($_.LocalAddress -eq '127.0.0.1' -or $_.LocalAddress -eq '::1') } | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess | Sort-Object LocalPort | Format-Table -AutoSize

note: Read-only check for Chrome local listening ports without reading browser credentials
